name: Knee Push-Up
description: A push-up from the knees: body straight from knees to head, lower your chest toward the floor and press back up.

source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Kneel with your hands on the floor just wider than your shoulders.
Walk your hands forward until your body is a straight line from knees to head.
cues: Keep your hips in line; don't let them sag or pike.
Elbows angle back, not straight out.
Lower until your upper arms are level, then press up.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Arms straight
keyframes.cue: Body straight from knees to head.

keyframes.name: Lower
keyframes.cue: Bend your elbows and lower your chest.
